title: Quantitative Genetics for Plant Breeding
description: This open textbook is intended to expose students to the application of quantitative genetic models to plant breeding populations. Specific topics include conducting and interpreting multi-environment trials, resource allocation using engineering principles, genetic modeling of quantitative traits, simulation modeling, variance, covariance and heritability, prediction, selection, and genetic gain.
authors: Walter Suza - Editor / Kendall Lamkey - Editor
